ruleDefinitions.name: Usage Of Web Request Commands And Cmdlets - ScriptBlock
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of various web request commands with commandline tools and Windows PowerShell cmdlets (including aliases) via PowerShell scriptblock logs Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText, Path

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[System\\\.Net\\\.WebRequest\\]\\:\\:create.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*curl\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-RestMethod.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-WebRequest.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ irm\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*iwr\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Net\\\.WebClient.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Resume\\-BitsTransfer.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Start\\-BitsTransfer.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*wget\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WinHttp\\\.WinHttpRequest.*")) AND  NOT (Path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Packages\\\\Plugins\\\\Microsoft\\\.GuestConfiguration\\\.ConfigurationforWindows\\\\"))
